title: Southern Dreams on 30A
meta_description: Southern Dreams on 30A: a 4-bed Dune Allen Beach home sleeping 14, with a bunk room, community pool \& beach access nearby.
description_expanded:
Bright, breezy, and built for easy group getaways, Southern Dreams on 30A sits in Dune Allen Beach, the quiet westernmost stretch of Florida's 30A, close to the sugar-white sand and clear water of the Emerald Coast.

This laid-back pocket of Santa Rosa Beach is known for its rare coastal dune lakes and unhurried pace, and the home lands you right in the middle of it. A Dune Allen beach access sits nearby, an easy walk or bike ride, and Stinky's Fish Camp is just down the road for Gulf seafood. Pedal the scenic paths, spend an afternoon among the shops, dining, and live music at Gulf Place Town Center a short ride east, or explore the trails and undeveloped shoreline of Topsail Hill Preserve State Park before heading back to a home base made for slowing down.

Inside, an open-concept layout keeps the living, dining, and kitchen areas flowing together, so the group never feels far apart. The living room is set up for lazy movie nights, and the dining table for six pulls everyone in for shared meals. The kitchen handles it all, with stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and a breakfast bar for quick mornings or full spreads.

Outside, the Florida sunshine takes over. Fire up the grill for an evening cookout, settle into the outdoor lounge, or land on the back porch as the breeze and birdsong set the pace. Mornings run just as slow: bring your coffee out to the balcony chairs and watch the neighborhood wake up. When the heat climbs, cool off in the community pool, an easy reset after a day at the beach.

Four bedrooms sleep up to 14. The main-level primary suite has a king and a private ensuite, a quiet corner to retreat to. Two more bedrooms each hold a queen and share a full bathroom, while the bunk room --- two twin-over-full bunks plus a sleeper sofa, with its own bathroom nearby --- is an easy favorite for kids and bigger groups. A main-level half bath and an in-home washer and dryer round things out for longer stays.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside to Santa Rosa Beach and beyond, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A golf cart is available on-site for guest use. A signed liability waiver is required. Once the waiver is submitted, you'll receive an email with the lockbox code to retrieve the keys.
- Pack 'n play is available upon request

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking is available for 3 cars and 1 golf cart. No street parking allowed---violators may be towed.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit: STR-104354
